cold_open.hook: AMD just posted its biggest quarter ever—then immediately tanked 7.5 percent. We're talking about the company that's supposed to be winning.

markets.macro_note: Mega-cap tech rolling over; VIX down but breadth narrowing—rotation into consumer staples and payments.

big_story.story_title: AMD rides data center riches to 'largest and most profitable' quarter in history
big_story.angle: AMD crushed earnings and raised 2027 guidance to 80%+ revenue growth with data center as the core engine—but the stock is punished anyway, exposing the gap between AI narrative and actual investor conviction.

quick_hits.angle: AMD forecasts 80%+ revenue growth in 2027 with data center hitting 80% of total revenue—the company is basically betting its entire future on one customer segment not imploding.
Disney is cutting thousands and asking managers to slash costs by 20%—Iger's cost-cutting theater is back, and it's happening right as streaming is supposed to be profitable.
Canva is laying off 22 percent of staff after a massive valuation run—the design-tool darling is discovering that viral adoption doesn't automatically print money.
Yum Brands beat earnings but Taco Bell is getting hammered by a cyclospora outbreak—a literal foodborne illness is now a line item in the earnings call.

odd_thing.joke_angle: People are leaving 'I Voted' stickers at ICE memorials—the most American way to turn a civic duty into a grief ritual.

yesterday_callback.topic: ORCL down 8.8 percent — and that's not even the headline.
yesterday_callback.fresh_take: Oracle is down 8.76% today, but AMD's 7.5% drop is the real story—both mega-cap AI plays are getting sold, suggesting the market is finally pricing in that not every company can be the next Nvidia.

sign_off.callback_target: AMD's 80% data center bet—the company that's supposed to be winning but the stock is punished anyway
